# Game Idea: Canvas Rocket Escape

- **Gameplay**: Control a rocket that thrusts and rotates to dodge an endless stream of moving asteroids on an HTML canvas. Collect fuel cells to extend your flight.
- **Goal**: Survive as long as possible while maneuvering through the asteroid field.
- **Lose Condition**: The game ends if the rocket collides with an asteroid or runs out of fuel.

1: // Simple Rocket Escape game
2: // Canvas id="game". Rocket can thrust (ArrowUp) and rotate (ArrowLeft/Right).
3: // Asteroids drift left to right, fuel cells appear occasionally.
4: // Survive as long as possible.
5: 
6: (() => {
7:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
8:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
9:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
10:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
11:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
12: 
13:   // ----- Game objects -----
14:   // Star field for background
15:   const stars = [];
16:   const starCount = 100;
17:   for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
18:     stars.push({
19:       x: Math.random() * width,
20:       y: Math.random() * height,
21:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
22:     });
23:   }
24:   const rocket = {
25:     x: width / 2,
26:     y: height - 50,
27:     angle: -Math.PI / 2, // pointing up
28:     vx: 0,
29:     vy: 0,
30:     size: 20,
31:     thrust: 0.1,
32:     rotateSpeed: 0.07,
33:     fuel: 100,
34:   };
35: 
36:   const asteroids = [];
37:   const fuels = [];
38:   let keys = {};
39:   // Audio context for sound effects
40:   let audioCtx = null;
41:   function playSound(freq, duration) {
42:     if (!audioCtx) return;
43:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
44:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
45:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
46:     osc.type = 'sine';
47:     osc.connect(gain);
48:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
49:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
50:     osc.start();
51:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
52:   }
53:   function playThrustSound() { playSound(300, 0.05); }
54:   function playCollisionSound() { playSound(150, 0.4); }
55:   let score = 0;
56:   let gameOver = false;
57: 
58:   // ----- Input handling -----
59:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
60:     if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
61:     keys[e.code] = true;
62:   });
63:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => (keys[e.code] = false));
64: 
65:   // ----- Helpers -----
66:   function spawnAsteroid() {
67:     const size = 15 + Math.random() * 30;
68:     const speed = 1 + Math.random() * 2;
69:     const side = Math.random() < 0.5 ? 'left' : 'right';
70:     const y = Math.random() * (height / 2);
71:     const rotation = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
72:     const rotSpeed = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02;
73:     asteroids.push({
74:       x: side === 'left' ? -size : width + size,
75:       y,
76:       vx: side === 'left' ? speed : -speed,
77:       vy: 0,
78:       size,
79:       rotation,
80:       rotSpeed,
81:     });
82:   }
83: 
84: 
85:   function spawnFuel() {
86:     const size = 10;
87:     const x = Math.random() * (width - size * 2) + size;
88:     const y = Math.random() * (height / 2) + size;
89:     fuels.push({ x, y, size, collected: false });
90:   }
91: 
92:   function updateRocket() {
93:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) rocket.angle -= rocket.rotateSpeed;
94:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) rocket.angle += rocket.rotateSpeed;
95: if (keys['ArrowUp'] && rocket.fuel > 0) {
96:     rocket.vx += Math.cos(rocket.angle) * rocket.thrust;
97:     rocket.vy += Math.sin(rocket.angle) * rocket.thrust;
98:     rocket.fuel -= 0.2;
99:     playThrustSound();
100:   }
101:     // Apply simple drag & gravity-like pull downwards
102:     rocket.vx *= 0.99;
103:     rocket.vy *= 0.99;
104:     rocket.vy += 0.02; // slight gravity
105:     rocket.x += rocket.vx;
106:     rocket.y += rocket.vy;
107:     // Keep within bounds
108:     if (rocket.x < 0) rocket.x = width;
109:     if (rocket.x > width) rocket.x = 0;
110:     if (rocket.y < 0) rocket.y = 0;
111:     if (rocket.y > height) { gameOver = true; }
112:   }
113: 
114:   function updateObjects() {
115:     // Move stars slowly to create parallax (twinkle)
116:     stars.forEach(s => {
117:       s.y += 0.2; // slow downward drift
118:       if (s.y > height) s.y = 0;
119:       // tiny random size change for twinkle
120:       s.radius += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1;
121:       if (s.radius < 0.5) s.radius = 0.5;
122:       if (s.radius > 2) s.radius = 2;
123:     });
124:     // Asteroids move and rotate
125:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
126:       a.x += a.vx;
127:       a.y += a.vy;
128:       a.rotation += a.rotSpeed;
129:     });
130:     // Remove off‑screen
131:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
132:       if (asteroids[i].x < -50 || asteroids[i].x > width + 50) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
133:     }
134:     // Fuels remain static
135:   }
136:   }
137: 
138:   function checkCollisions() {
139:     // Rocket vs asteroids
140:     for (let a of asteroids) {
141:       const dx = rocket.x - a.x;
142:       const dy = rocket.y - a.y;
143:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
144: if (dist < rocket.size + a.size) {
145:           playCollisionSound();
146:           gameOver = true;
147:           return;
148:         }
149:     }
150:     // Rocket vs fuels
151:     for (let f of fuels) {
152:       if (f.collected) continue;
153:       const dx = rocket.x - f.x;
154:       const dy = rocket.y - f.y;
155:       if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) < rocket.size + f.size) {
156:         f.collected = true;
157:         rocket.fuel = Math.min(rocket.fuel + 30, 100);
158:         score += 10;
159:       }
160:     }
161:   }
162: 
163:   function draw() {
164:     // Clear and draw star field background
165:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, width, height);
166:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
167:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
168:     ctx.fillStyle = '#555';
169:     for (let s of stars) {
170:       ctx.beginPath();
171:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
172:       ctx.fill();
173:     }
174:     // Rocket with optional thrust flame
175:     ctx.save();
176:     ctx.translate(rocket.x, rocket.y);
177:     ctx.rotate(rocket.angle);
178:     // Flame when thrusting
179:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && rocket.fuel > 0) {
180:       ctx.beginPath();
181:       ctx.moveTo(-rocket.size / 2, 0);
182:       ctx.lineTo(-rocket.size, rocket.size / 2);
183:       ctx.lineTo(-rocket.size / 2, rocket.size);
184:       ctx.closePath();
185:       ctx.fillStyle = 'orange';
186:       ctx.fill();
187:     }
188:     ctx.beginPath();
189:     ctx.moveTo(rocket.size, 0);
190:     ctx.lineTo(-rocket.size / 2, rocket.size / 2);
191:     ctx.lineTo(-rocket.size / 2, -rocket.size / 2);
192:     ctx.closePath();
193:     ctx.fillStyle = '#ff0';
194:     ctx.fill();
195:     ctx.restore();
196:     // Asteroids with rotation
197:     for (let a of asteroids) {
198:       ctx.save();
199:       ctx.translate(a.x, a.y);
200:       ctx.rotate(a.rotation);
201:       ctx.fillStyle = '#777';
202:       ctx.beginPath();
203:       ctx.arc(0, 0, a.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
204:       ctx.fill();
205:       ctx.restore();
206:     }
207:     // Fuel cells
208:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
209:     for (let f of fuels) {
210:       if (f.collected) continue;
211:       ctx.beginPath();
212:       ctx.arc(f.x, f.y, f.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
213:       ctx.fill();
214:     }
215:     // HUD
216:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
217:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
218:     ctx.fillText(`Score: ${score}`, 10, 20);
219:     ctx.fillText(`Fuel: ${Math.floor(rocket.fuel)}`, 10, 40);
220:     if (gameOver) {
221:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
222:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
223:       ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
224:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
225:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
226:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', width / 2, height / 2);
227:     }
228:   }
229: 
230:   // ----- Main loop -----
231:   let lastSpawn = 0;
232:   let lastFuelSpawn = 0;
233:   function loop(timestamp) {
234:     if (gameOver) {
235:       draw();
236:       return;
237:     }
238:     const delta = timestamp - (lastSpawn || timestamp);
239:     // Spawn asteroids every 1–2 seconds
240:     if (timestamp - lastSpawn > 1000 + Math.random() * 1000) {
241:       spawnAsteroid();
242:       lastSpawn = timestamp;
243:     }
244:     // Spawn fuel cells occasionally
245:     if (timestamp - lastFuelSpawn > 8000) {
246:       spawnFuel();
247:       lastFuelSpawn = timestamp;
248:     }
249:     updateRocket();
250:     updateObjects();
251:     checkCollisions();
252:     draw();
253:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
254:   }
255: 
256:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
257: })();

(End of file - total 257 lines)
</content>
